comparison.objective: Install two chute gates and open a slide gate so balls flow into a green bin; candidate breaks and recovers tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Gate insertion and articulation controlling bulk flow versus precision mandrel placement, hammer impact and individual fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Both gates are in place, slide gate opens, balls reach the green bin and arms release; candidate requires four notch fractures and four contained tangs without damage.
comparison.reason: The record tests mechanism setup and flow routing, not impact-driven fracture despite both requiring containment of loose objects.
